messages:
Maya Ortiz: quick sync - weaving together Snowflake connector, Delta Lake path on Databricks, and a lightweight Milvus vector backend for the pilot. need single source runbook and clear owners.
Kai Nguyen: i'll own the connector integration tests. can we define a minimal E2E smoke: ingest -> transform -> vectorize -> query?
Ravi Desai: yes. i'll provide sample ETL jobs and a 100k doc sample. also need to confirm schema mapping rules for nested JSON.
Clara Hu: ops ask: what telemetry do we expose to marketplace customers vs internal only? proposal: tenant-scoped metrics for latency/throughput, internal debug logs behind flag.
Maya Ortiz: agree on tenant-scoped metrics. also need a documented fallback: if Milvus indexing fails, write events to Snowflake staging table and alert.
Kai Nguyen: perf targets proposal: query P95 < 200ms at 30qps for vector search, indexing >= 2500 docs/min, Snowflake COPY latency < 6min for 1GB.
Ravi Desai: those targets look reasonable. SI team requested OAuth flow + keypair support for SSO on the Databricks side.
Clara Hu: security gating: DPA + KMS pattern clarified: for pilots prefer customer KMS; fallback to Redwood-managed with strict ACLs. add to runbook.
Maya Ortiz: marketplace listing asks: metadata (supported regions, SKUs), install modes (sidecar / managed), and a short demo gif. Marketing will draft.
VendorsBot: reminder: submit connector package for vendor-scanning by 2026-07-01T23:59Z
Kai Nguyen: i'll open a PR with test harness and a README describing acceptance criteria. linking to infra terraform for reproducible perf runs.
Ravi Desai: i'll prep the sample datasets and manifest by 06/20. will include a mapping table for nested->flattened fields.
Clara Hu: add rollback steps: disable marketplace routing, switch to read-only mode for connectors, and a circuit-breaker to stop indexing jobs.
Maya Ortiz: great. next: Kai finalize test harness by 06/25, Ravi deliver data artifacts by 06/20, Clara run security checklist with Sarah by 06/28. reconvene next Tue.
